title: Node Red→Amber easing and Amber→None (CLEARED Node_Strained) transitions untested — the cleared-sign pin is half-uncovered for nodes
detail: P0 pin 'one-event-per-transition — the cleared sign must name the level that ENDED': node easing (Red→Amber) and Amber→None (CLEARED Node_Strained) are never asserted; only the pipe analogs are. A node-transition regression passes every test.
recommended_fix: Add a node test that eases Red→Amber (assert CLEARED Node_Critical, strained persists) and one that clears Amber→None (assert CLEARED Node_Strained names the level that ended).

title: Pipe-pressure replication to member pipes untested — all strain scenarios use single-member bundles
evidence:
core/warnings_test.odin:145-181 (test_pipe_pressure_lane_bound) — one pipe in the bundle (sla_draw(&s, cat, res, rt, "standard", 1)); the only pipe stream asserted: 
		{tick = 1, tag = EVENT_TAG_WARNING_RAISED, sign = u8(Warning_Sign.Pipe_Critical), target = 0},
		{tick = 3, tag = EVENT_TAG_WARNING_CLEARED, sign = u8(Warning_Sign.Pipe_Critical), target = 0},
		{tick = 5, tag = EVENT_TAG_WARNING_CLEARED, sign = u8(Warning_Sign.Pipe_Pressure), target = 0},
core/warnings.odin:212-223 — the replication loop, never exercised with >= 2 members: 
	// --- 4. pipe levels (each pipe carries its bundle's pressure) + events
	for ps in 0..<len(t.pipe_alive) {
		...
		cr.pipe_strain[ps] = pipe_strain_transition(state, tick, cr.pipe_strain[ps], new, t.pipe_id[ps])
demos/warn.dem: 'at 100ms draw 0 1 standard' / 'at 100ms draw 3 1 standard' / 'at 100ms draw 4 1 standard' — three distinct single-member bundles
detail: P0 pin 'pressure replicating to member pipes': every strain scenario (unit tests and warn.dem) uses single-member bundles, and tests assert only pipe 0's events. A regression writing levels to one member of a parallel bundle goes undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a test drawing two parallel pipes (one bundle), saturating one lane, and asserting both members' strain levels and events replicate identically.

title: Router strain pins (1 stuck = 75% amber, 2 = 150% red) have zero test coverage
evidence:
core/warnings_test.odin:83-84: 'Host throughput 80: 1 packet = 37 % (healthy), 2 = 75 % (amber), 3 = 112 % (red)' — the only strain-math pin uses the content_host divisor.
spec design notes: 'Router (40 u/s): amber at 1 waiting packet (75 %), red at 2 (150 %); content_host (80): amber at 2, red at 3; residential: red at any waiting packet (600 %)'.
demos/warn.dem: 'host Node_Strained @1 (2 waiting = 75% of the 80 u/s host throughput)'
detail: P0 pins name the router (1 stuck = 75% amber, 2 = 150% red) and residential (any = 600% red); all unit pins use the host's 80 u/s divisor. Residential is E2E-pinned via warn.dem; the router is never strained.
recommended_fix: Add a test with stuck packets at a router_basic node asserting amber at 1 waiting packet and red at 2 (the 40 u/s divisor).

title: strain_level inclusive bounds at exactly 70/90 never exercised — all pins cross strictly
evidence:
core/warnings.odin:80-85:
strain_level :: proc(pct: i64, amber, red: i32) -> Strain_Level {
	if pct >= i64(red) do return .Red
	if pct >= i64(amber) do return .Amber
	return .None
}
core/warnings_test.odin:99-101 + 176-178: measured percents 75, 112 (nodes) and 100, 83 (pipe) — all strictly above 70/90; exactly 70 and exactly 90 are never measured, and no direct strain_level unit test exists (grep of *_test.odin: none). The lane-at-exactly-the-bound case (6/6 = 100%) IS covered.
detail: strain_level's inclusive bounds (>= amber, >= red) are never exercised at exactly 70/90 — every pin crosses strictly (75/112/83/100). A >=→> regression at the exact thresholds passes all tests; the boundary heuristic is unmet for percents (the lane-bound case is covered).
recommended_fix: Add a strain_level unit test with pct == amber and pct == red (inclusive) plus 69/89/91, pinning the exact boundary semantics.

title: waiting_ticks clear on E29 drop-back untested
evidence: core/flow.odin:753: 'p.waiting_ticks = 0 // 4.1: a severed drop-back re-tries fresh next tick' — grep of *_test.odin finds no reference to waiting_ticks outside flow/serialize/warnings; no test severs a pipe mid-traversal and checks the drop-backed packet's counter.
detail: The E29 drop-back clear is waiting_ticks' third bookkeeping path (besides increment and forward-clear); no test severs a pipe mid-traversal and checks the drop-backed packet stays strain-neutral.
recommended_fix: Extend a demolish test: sever a pipe with an on-edge packet, then assert the drop-backed packet has waiting_ticks 0 and does not strain its node.

title: Forecast purity unasserted — window test clears events without checking emptiness
evidence: core/warnings_test.odin:185-224 (test_forecast_window_rows): the check helper steps and then 'clear(&s.events)' (line 212) with no assertion that the buffer stayed empty; the header comment says 'pure schedule reads: no traffic needed (the forecast is a function of era + tick + catalog)'. test_zero_traffic_neutral asserts zero events but at era 0, where no forecast rows exist.
detail: The forecast window test clears the events buffer without asserting it stayed empty — a hypothetical forecast-emitted event would pass. E24 neutrality is asserted only at era 0, where no forecast rows exist.
recommended_fix: In test_forecast_window_rows, assert len(s.events) == 0 before each clear — pinning that forecast rows never emit events.

title: qos_first_word_after_topology walker stale: doesn't skip the SLA/warnings sections; no byte-level absent-when-empty pin for the warnings section
evidence: core/qos_test.odin:284-319: the walker comment claims 'The 3.2 QoS sections sit at that offset and are ABSENT-WHEN-EMPTY, so the word is EITHER the weights count (sections present) OR the action-log length (no QoS bytes at all)' — but it skips only flow + topology; core/serialize.odin:132 ('// 3.4 SLA accumulators') and :169 ('// 4.1 warning state') place two more absent-when-empty sections between next_packet_id and the topology. test_zero_traffic_neutral (warnings_test.odin:227-251) asserts state levels, never the serialized section bytes.
detail: The walker skips only flow + topology, not the 3.4 SLA and 4.1 warnings sections that now precede the topology — it parses only when both are empty. No test byte-pins the warnings section's absent-when-empty (E24 test checks state, not bytes).
recommended_fix: Teach the walker to skip the SLA + warnings sections (count-driven), and add a byte-level check that a zero-traffic era-3 tick emits no warnings-section bytes.

title: pipe_amber_pct < 0 fail-fast row missing from catalog_test
evidence: core/catalog_test.odin:232: '{"node amber negative", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"node_amber_pct": 70`, `"node_amber_pct": -1`, 1), "strain ladder"},' — there is no 'pipe amber negative' row. core/catalog.odin:537: 'b.warnings.node_red_pct > 100 || b.warnings.pipe_amber_pct < 0 ||' — the pipe-negative check exists in code but is untested. The other 9 warnings fail-fast rows are covered.
detail: The loader fail-fasts on pipe_amber_pct < 0 (catalog.odin:537), but only the node-negative row is tested; the pipe-negative fail-fast row is missing (the other 9 warnings rows are covered).
recommended_fix: Add the mirrored row: replace1(BAL_VALID, `"pipe_amber_pct": 70`, `"pipe_amber_pct": -1`, 1), expecting "strain ladder".

title: Stuck + healthy-transit mixture at one node unpinned (the sharpest no-flicker case)
evidence: core/warnings_test.odin:108-142 (test_node_strain_no_flicker_healthy_transit): every packet is a healthy transit on a fully-routed path — 'each packet forwards every tick it is at a node (healthy path), so waiting_ticks stays 0 and NOTHING strains' — no node ever holds a stuck backlog alongside a fresh transit. core/warnings.odin:189: 'if p.waiting_ticks == 0 { continue }' — the mixture gate is never pinned.
detail: The sharpest no-flicker case — a healthy transit arriving at a node that is also straining, proving the transit adds 0 while stuck packets count — is unpinned: test (b) has no stuck backlog anywhere.
recommended_fix: Add a scenario with one stuck packet at a node plus a transit arriving there, asserting the strain reflects only the stuck packet's bandwidth.
